Sara (partnerships): Heads up — I'm kicking off a short run to stitch the SI co-sell pipeline for Q2. Need to finalize lead handoff, account mapping, and marketplace/hardware partner alignment. Quick check in?
Devin (sales): Yep. Main asks from sales: clear ownership rules, how invoice/origination works, and how long the claim window is.
Ajay (solutions): From the SI side: we need a 48h claim window after intake to do discovery + pre-demo. Also want a flag for pre-demo ownership so we don't double-book. For announcements: marketplace listing should be coordinated with SI comms.
Maya (legal): Heads up — announcements will need an MOU template and approval flow. Recommend 7 business days for legal review on joint materials.
Sara (partnerships): Proposed rules: 48h claim window, shared owner tags in SFDC (partner_owner vs redwood_owner), canonical marketplace SKU -> partner ID mapping, announcement gating (launch then partner sign-off). Thoughts?
Tom (engineering): To support SKU mapping we need a single canonical field in intake. Suggest adding partner_id and hw_partner_sku to the intake payload. Example snippet for intake API:
```json
{
  "account_id": "SFDC-12345",
  "lead_source": "si-intake",
  "partner_id": "si-omega-987",
  "hw_partner_sku": "NVIDIA-RTX-A4000-REDWOOD",
  "claimed_by": "",
  "claim_ts": ""
}
```
Ajay (solutions): That works. Also request: fallback routing — if SI doesn't claim within 48h, route the lead to the assigned Redwood AE automatically.
Devin (sales): Agreed. Additionally: any deal > $250k should auto-escalate to AE + Partnerships ops for a co-sell play and joint discount approval.
Sara (partnerships): Action items: Ajay + Devin — finalize claim rules and escalation thresholds. Tom — add partner_id + hw_partner_sku to intake schema. Maya — draft MOU template and approval flow. I'll compile a playbook doc.
ops-bot: Reminder — partnership intake form updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-intake (new fields added).
Ajay (solutions): One more — marketplace private offers need to be synced with partner's HW SKU for bundling. We should enforce hw_partner_sku for private-marketplace offers.
Tom (engineering): We'll make hw_partner_sku optional but recommended. ETA for schema change: 5 working days.
Devin (sales): :thumbsup: Can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow 11am PT to lock this? @Ajay @Maya
Sara (partnerships): Booked — 11am PT. I'll drop a draft playbook before the call.
Ajay (solutions): Added initial notes and a mapping table to the confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-intake#pipeline-stitching
Devin (sales): Great, thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.
Sara (partnerships): Closing loop — expect playbook v0 before EOD and I'll follow up with meeting invite + agenda.
